WHO YOU ARE - You have 3+ years of experience building and operating backend systems in production, not just shipping features into one. - You’re strong in Python, and comfortable enough in TypeScript to own infrastructure code (or keen to learn). - You have hands-on experience integrating with REST APIs from SaaS applications, and you’ve moved and transformed data between them. You know what idempotency, retries, eventual consistency and reconciliation mean in practice. - You have experience with a cloud platform, ideally Azure (AWS or GCP translates fine), and with infrastructure as code. - You’re genuinely interested in how a business makes and books money. Experience with financial systems (billing, revenue, ERP) is a plus. - You’re proactive, self-directed and hungry. You take ownership of a system and thrive with a lot of autonomy in a fast-moving, high-growth company. Enterprise means depth: larger, more complex accounts with more revenue at stake. Each account is a global legal function with multiple teams, jurisdictions and business units, its own governance, and a long, multi-phase roadmap. Success depends on navigating that complexity: aligning General Counsel, legal operations, IT, security and procurement, and building momentum one team and one use case at a time until Legora is used across the whole function. At the heart of the role is designing each client's enterprise adoption strategy and delivering the change programmes that transform how they work. For every account you will build a tailored, multi-year roadmap, sequence initiatives from the first pilot teams to function-wide and global adoption, define measurable outcomes and ROI with executive sponsors, and evolve the programme as new AI capabilities and use cases emerge. You will be critical as we continue to build a best-in-class enterprise adoption programme at Legora, helping clients realise measurable ROI, expand successful use cases and transform the way their teams work. WHAT YOU'LL DO You'll lead the post-sale customer experience, owning onboarding, adoption and long-term value realisation for a portfolio of enterprise accounts.
